item.title: Shawangunks Loop Hike — Sun Aug 23, 9:00 AM
item.description: Metrotrails: NJ, PA, NY Metropolitan Area Hiking and More! Join us for this interesting loop hike in the Shawangunks of New York! For this 15 mile loop trip, we will meet at the Foordmore Trailhead for the Long Path near Kerkhonksen New York. The most difficult parts will be the very beginning where we ascend the Shawangunk Ridge on backroads and the Stony Kill Carriageway. Once we reach the top of the ridge, we continue a bit through the blueberry lands, and then descend a bit on Smiley Carriageway. There will be one rough bit of trail down to a waterfall, and then more pleasant back roads. There is one bit that has metal rungs to climb up, but it is quite short. I'll be prepared with a pack to carry all of Ev's stuff for this stretch. The only regular road walk stuff is pretty much at the very beginning, and the beginning of the ascent. item.title: Hike with Dr. Kirk! 3-4 miles — Sat Aug 29, 4:00 PM
item.description:
South Mountain Conservancy Activities Meetup Group **Saturday, August 29 4-7pm**
Free expert-led hike in South Mountain Reservation.
Hike about 2-3 hours covering 3-4 miles at a modest pace over rocky trails with one long climb from the Rahway River up South Mountain. Focus on ecology and hydrology, led by Dr. Kirk Barrett, President of the Rahway Watershed Association and expert on local watershed issues. Good balance required. Children welcome. No dogs. Sponsered by South Mountain Conservancy and the Rahway River Watershed Association.
Meet at Clipper Pavilion (Not by McLoone's) on Cherry Lane in West Orange.
[Advance registration required via rahwayriver.org/calendar.html ](https://rahwayriver.org/calendar.html)Email president@rahwayriver.org with questions.
Leader: Dr. Kirk Barrett, President of the Rahway River Watershed Association (RRWA) and expert on local watershed issues.
Meet at: The gazebo by the dog park along Crest Drive in Maplewood.

item.description: Metrotrails: NJ, PA, NY Metropolitan Area Hiking and More! Join us for this point to point 15 mile hike, the next in the Brandywine Series! This time, we'll travel between Delacy Soccer Complex in East Bradford Township and Downingtown. We already covered some of Downingtown previously, but this time we'll cover some other municipal trails and former route of the Brandywine Trail near the beginning, as well as the end of Struble Trail, Lions Trail, and we'll trace the historic route of the Pennsylvania Railroad New Holland Branch briefly. We take another municipal trail from here south to a pleasant back road with no lines in it, and then revisit the Harmony Hill Covered Bridge. item.title: Silent Book Club (West Essex Chapter) — Mon Oct 26, 5:30 PM — West Caldwell - New Book Area
item.description:
Silent Book Club is a global community of readers with nearly 2,000 chapters in 55 countries. There's no assigned reading — it's bring your own book.
More than a million members gather in person, online, and in destinations around the world to read together and swap stories. All readers are welcome!
HOW IT WORKS: Bring your own book. Grab a seat. Enjoy a quiet reading hour.
There are no assigned readings, no pressure to socialize. All book formats are welcome (headphones for audiobooks).
From 5:30-6pm, participants arrive, find their seats and chat with other book lovers about what you are reading.
From 6-7pm, please enjoy the quiet reading hour and from 7-7:30pm you can continue to read or socialize.
More info: https://bookclubs.com/clubs/6085923/join/676f73/

item.title: Kayaking: Guided Paddle through the Sawmill Creek Wildlife Management Area — Sat Aug 8, 4:45 PM — Montclair Public Library
item.description:
Note: This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
Known by many as the “Jewel of the Meadowlands,” the Sawmill Wildlife Management Area is the oldest protected wetlands in the NJ Meadowlands District - and is home to a remarkable variety of birds, fish and other wildlife. Before setting out in the company of experienced guides, students will receive a briefing conducted by a senior Hackensack Riverkeeper staff person who will explain the organization’s ongoing work and mission; and speak about some of the creatures you are most likely to encounter while on the water and in the wetlands.
PLEASE NOTE: We offer both single kayaks & tandem kayaks that fit two paddlers. These will be distributed on a first come, first served basis upon arrival at Laurel Hill Park.
If you need kayaking lessons ahead of the tour you can register for them individually through the Hackensack Riverkeepers.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306

Tech Talks is a free informational series where library staff introduce and explain the technology topics that matter most in today's digital world. Each session takes a closer look at a new or complex topic—whether it's a trending app, an emerging technology, or a platform you've been hearing about but aren't quite sure how to navigate. Through demonstrations and clear, jargon-free explanations, you'll come away with a better understanding of the tech landscape around you. THE JOURNEY OF PURA BELPRÉ’S TALES Pura Belpré was a talented author, collector of folktales, puppeteer and storyteller who wrote and reinterpreted Puerto Rican folk tales. Our show is a re-enactment of her legendary “Bilingual Story Hour” in a creative and interactive experience that combines storytelling with puppets!
El viaje de los cuentos de Pura Belpré Pura Belpré fue una talentosa escritora, coleccionista de cuentos tradicionales, titiritera y cuenta cuentos que escribió y re-interpretó las historias populares puertorriqueñas. Nuestro espectáculo es una recreación de su tradición de contar cuentos bilingües, en una experiencia creativa e inter- activa que combina el arte de contar cuentos con títeres
A REFORMA.ORG Noche de Cuentos grant funded event.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10341

item.title: Classic Films Now: All the President’s Men — Sun Oct 25, 2:00 PM
item.description:
Run Time: 140 minutes. Recommended for ages 13+. A nation distrusts its institutions. News has become spectacle. Ordinary people fight to matter. Welcome to 1976. Academy Award winners Robert Redford and Dustin Hoffman star in this true story as Washington Post reporters Carl Bernstein and Bob Woodward, whose investigation of a seemingly minor hotel room break-in uncovers the greatest political scandal in United States history and leads to the downfall of President Richard Nixon.
Classic Films Now brings major works of cinema back to the big screen, films that not only defined their own time but continue to speak to ours. Each installment of the series gathers a group of landmark films curated around a theme, period, artist, or movement, inviting audiences to discover how the works connect with contemporary life. item.title: SMC Trail Work Volunteer Day — Sun Aug 2, 9:00 AM
item.description:
South Mountain Conservancy Activities Meetup Group **TRAIL WORK will continue rerouting the Hogenauer Trail** up the slope and away from recently installed property fences. **Meet At:** Dog Park/ Wildflower Preserve, 11 Bear Lane, Maplewood. From there, we will walk to Crater View on Crest drive and then to the Hogenauer trail work site.
Trail work is physically challenging but very satisfying as we use hand tools to build and repair trails. Participants must be 15+ years. Those younger than 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Participants **should wear long pants** due to [ticks](https://www.somocon.org/?page_id=193928&fb) and thron bushes and sturdy shoes, and bring gloves (though backup gloves will be available). Tools, water, and a snack will be provided. (Registration is not required though if you sign up on Meetup, it helps us know how many tools to bring.) Only heavy, steady rain cancels.
Source: Meetup: South Mountain Conservancy

item.title: Virtual Meditation — Wed Aug 5, 7:00 PM — NJ
item.description:
Summer session: July 1, 8, 22, 29. August 5, 12, 19 Wednesdays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM Join contemporary spiritual teacher and author Ramananda John E. Welshons (One Soul, One Love, One Heart, When Prayers Aren’t Answered and Awakening From Grief) for evening meditation classes in the comfort of your own home via Zoom. These classes will focus on specific practices for working with fear and anxiety. Participants will learn and practice different forms of mindfulness meditation in each session and will have the opportunity to participate in discussions of Ramananda’s three critically acclaimed books. Open to beginners and experienced practitioners, these gatherings offer an opportunity to experience deep inner peace while practicing with a highly experienced meditation teacher.
